title: Stasis Spells & Reflections
description: A nighttime view of a magical apothecary shop named 'Stasis Spells & Reflections' on a cobblestone street. A woman in a dark blue robe stands inside the large arched window, holding a glowing bottle, surrounded by floating potions, dried herbs, and shelves of magical bottles.
prompt: A magical apothecary shop at dusk on a cobblestone street with a large arched display window. A woman in a dark blue robe stands inside holding a glowing potion bottle.
